headword: {過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}

definitions.explanation: Consuming more of something (food, nutrients, medication, etc.) than is recommended or healthy.

examples.japanese: {塩分|えんぶん}の{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}に{注意|ちゅうい}する。
examples.english: To be careful about excessive salt intake.

examples.japanese: {糖分|とうぶん}の{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}は{肥満|ひまん}の{原因|げんいん}になる。
examples.english: Excessive sugar intake leads to obesity.

examples.japanese: サプリメントの{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}は{健康|けんこう}に{害|がい}を{及|およ}ぼすことがある。
examples.english: Excessive intake of supplements can harm your health.

notes:
A compound of {過剰|かじょう} (excessive, surplus) and {摂取|せっしゅ} (intake, ingestion). Commonly used in health, nutrition, and medical contexts. Can refer to food, nutrients, medication, or substances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塩分|えんぶん}の{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}: excessive salt intake
- {糖分|とうぶん}の{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}: excessive sugar intake
- カロリーの{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}: excessive calorie intake
- {薬|くすり}の{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}: drug overdose

RELATED WORDS:
- {摂取|せっしゅ}: intake, ingestion — the neutral base word
- {過剰|かじょう}: excessive, surplus — also used in {過剰反応|かじょうはんのう} (overreaction)
- {過量投与|かりょうとうよ}: overdosage — a medical term for administering too much medication
